title: GetConfigurationResponse
description: Response containing the requested configuration entries and any unknown keys. A WriteOnly key MUST NOT appear in configuration[] however the request reached it; the exclusion is a prose rule in 08-configuration.md section 1.3, not something this schema can express, because expressing it would require enumerating key names here and the registry also admits vendor keys. Note that 'readonly' is a boolean and carries no third state for WriteOnly: none is needed, since a WriteOnly key is absent from the response entirely. A refusal is carried by errorCode and errorText, added in 0.35.0; there is no 'status' member and none is needed, because the presence of errorCode is itself the discriminator. 'configuration' stays REQUIRED on every branch: a refusing station has zero entries to report and the empty array says exactly that -- a value this message already carried, and one get-configuration.md section 6 already makes mandatory when every requested key is unknown. On a refusal both arrays are empty, because a station that did not process the request classified no key as unknown either.

errorCode.description: The numeric registry code of a refusal. Its presence is what makes the response a refusal, so it travels with errorText and with an empty configuration array.

errorText.description: The registry NAME of the refusal, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Travels with errorCode; neither is emitted alone.
